## Project Overview

This project explores the breakdown of police spending and social spending in each of Washington state's 39 counties between 2020 and 2025. Using Washington crime data, I calculate crime rate by county for both violent offenses and other offenses to explore the relationship between police spending, social spending, and types of crime. I identify changes in social spending and police spending per capita over the period 2020 to 2025, and evaluate the impact of growth in either area of spending on crime rates.
